latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor or Maker — Initial Release

- Launches user-friendly AI-powered video editing and creation skill.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; outputs 1080p MP4 videos.
- Handles upload, editing, timeline management, credits checking, and export to cloud.
- Automatic session and token management with anonymous access when needed.
- Includes robust status, error handling, and clear user feedback throughout the workflow.
- Designed for content creators and marketers to turn raw footage into polished, shareable videos in ~1-2 minutes.
